queries.query: Designing PFAS treatment studies that remain valid in real water. Prepare a focused review of how water-matrix effects should be tested and reported so that PFAS treatment performance can be translated beyond clean laboratory water.
Compare how organic matter, surfactants, inorganic ions, and other co-solutes alter physical separation and degradation processes.
Distinguish inhibitory, promotive, neutral, and interactive effects and relate them to treatment mechanism and PFAS properties.
Recommend a minimum matrix-characterization and matched-control framework for defensible cross-study comparison.
